question: Should OpenClaw accept this opt-in `includeFamily` contract for model-facing `chat.history` and `sessions_history`, including bounded reset-family archive visibility and rejection of `includeFamily` with `offset`?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically reviewed, but deciding whether model-facing tools may read archived reset-family transcript content is a product/security boundary choice that automation should not settle.

options.title: Accept bounded includeFamily
options.body: Merge this API shape after maintainer signoff, relying on opt-in use, target caps, current-session preservation, docs, and header-checked topic archives as the visibility boundary.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Keep the implementation direction but revise the API or visibility rules, such as limiting it to non-model clients or adding a clearer archive-history contract.

options.title: Pause for archive recovery design
options.body: Keep this PR unmerged or close it in favor of a broader maintainer-owned archive recovery design that also covers restore/re-index and UI browsing semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded includeFamily
recommendation.body: Merge this API shape after maintainer signoff, relying on opt-in use, target caps, current-session preservation, docs, and header-checked topic archives as the visibility boundary.
